Aisha (CS): Quick share — I'm drafting a tiny customer-facing runbook for the onboarding handshake. Goal: capture renewal signals during go-live while keeping latency/cost in check. Focus areas: simple pre-warm steps, when to use batching vs streaming, and a tiny feedback capture snippet. Pls skim and flag anything confusing.

Tom (FieldEng): This looks great. Can we make the customer steps one-click/simple? many CSMs won't run curl.

Aisha (CS): Yes — two paths: 1) CSM copy-paste curl for technical customers, 2) One-click button we add to onboarding flow that calls the same endpoints. Draft checklist below — intended for the CSM playbook (copy to handoff email).

Aisha (CS): CHECKLIST (CS -> CUSTOMER) — pasteable to onboarding message:
• ✅ Step 0: Confirm sandbox keys + region. ask: "Which region will you serve from?"
• ✅ Step 1 (prefill cache): run one short prefill to warm common prompts (helps burst latency). Example (tech):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TENANT_X","prompts":["hello","order status","refund policy"]}'
```
• ✅ Step 2 (batching guidance): if you expect many parallel low-QPS requests (e.g. chatbots with many short turns), use batching window 20–40ms and batch size 8–16 for best cost/latency tradeoffs. For tiny scale (<5 RPS) prefer no aggressive batching.
• ✅ Step 3 (stream vs sync): enable streaming for long responses (>200 tokens) or interactive typing UX. streaming preserves perceived latency. synchronous better for short inference + deterministic billing.
• ✅ Step 4 (fallbacks): add a simple fallback route that hits a smaller model if latency > 750ms for 3 consecutive requests.

Naveen (SRE): Add SRE notes — rate limits + telemetry:
• Keep prefill rate <= 10 reqs/min per tenant to avoid warmup spikes.
• Tag prefill requests with header `X-Redwood-Prefill: true` so we can exclude from billing/alerts if needed.
• Recommend `Cache-TTL: 600` seconds for shared prefix caches during onboarding surge.

Becky (PM): We should capture explicit renewal signals during the handshake. Simple idea: 1) add a 2-question feedback flow in the onboarding confirmation (satisfaction + intent to renew). 2) emit a `renewal_signal` event when they hit production 1st-week usage > threshold.

Aisha (CS): Feedback capture snippet (customer-facing) to paste into onboarding UI or email:
```json
{
  "event":"onboard_feedback",
  "tenant":"TENANT_X",
  "satisfaction":"[1-5]",
  "intent_to_renew":"[yes/no/maybe]",
  "notes":"short free text"
}
```
We also suggest including the short telemetry keys in platform events: `warmup_success`, `median_latency_ms`, `prefill_count`, `batch_size_used`.

Tom (FieldEng): For non-technical CSMs: one-liner to paste to customer email: "We’ll warm up your account to improve first-week latency — you don’t need to do anything. If you'd like to run the quick warmup yourself, reply and we’ll send a one-click button."

Aisha (CS): Agreed — I'll add both variants (auto-warm and manual curl) to the handoff doc. Also adding a tiny troubleshooting table: common failure = invalid region key -> ask CSM to check region mismatch, common perf: if p50 > 500ms after warmup, enable streaming or bump batch window.

Naveen (SRE): One more ops tip: during large customer onboarding events enable a temporary capacity reservation or tag traffic so routing can prefer dedicated pools. Also set an alert: if prefill_success_rate < 80% during first 2 hours, page infra-team.

Becky (PM): Can we automate a small dashboard card for CSMs that shows: warmup_status, recent_latency_p50/p95, first_week_usage, renewal_signal_flag? That would make handoffs cleaner.

Aisha (CS): Yup — I'll add a sample dashboard spec to the runbook. Draft customer-facing blurb for onboarding email (pasteable): "We’ll run a quick warmup for your account to reduce early latency. This is low-cost and helps avoid timeouts during your first demos. We’ll also send a short 1–2 question check-in during week 1 to capture how valuable the integration is for your team."

Tom (FieldEng): LGTM. Small ask — include the minimal telemetry field list and example logging line so FieldEng can wire it to our analytics.

Aisha (CS): Good call. Example log line to include in onboarding events: `event=warmup result=success tenant=TENANT_X p50_ms=120 prefill_count=3 renew_signal=maybe`
